From 5c968f48021a9b3faa61ac2543cfab32461c0e05 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Alexander Couzens <lynxis@fe80.eu>
Date: Tue, 17 Jul 2018 13:17:09 +0200
Subject: [PATCH] net: usb: asix: replace mii_nway_restart in resume path

mii_nway_restart is not pm aware which results in a rtnl deadlock.
Implement mii_nway_restart manual by setting BMCR_ANRESTART if
BMCR_ANENABLE is set.

To reproduce:
* plug an asix based usb network interface
* wait until the device enters PM (~5 sec)
* `ip link set eth1 up` will never return

Fixes: d9fe64e51114 ("net: asix: Add in_pm parameter")
Signed-off-by: Alexander Couzens <lynxis@fe80.eu>
Signed-off-by: David S. Miller <davem@davemloft.net>

diff --git a/drivers/net/usb/asix_devices.c b/drivers/net/usb/asix_devices.c
index 3d4f7959dabb..b1b3d8f7e67d 100644
--- a/drivers/net/usb/asix_devices.c
+++ b/drivers/net/usb/asix_devices.c
@@ -642,10 +642,12 @@ static void ax88772_restore_phy(struct usbnet *dev)
 				     priv->presvd_phy_advertise);
 
 		/* Restore BMCR */
+		if (priv->presvd_phy_bmcr & BMCR_ANENABLE)
+			priv->presvd_phy_bmcr |= BMCR_ANRESTART;
+
 		asix_mdio_write_nopm(dev->net, dev->mii.phy_id, MII_BMCR,
 				     priv->presvd_phy_bmcr);
 
-		mii_nway_restart(&dev->mii);
 		priv->presvd_phy_advertise = 0;
 		priv->presvd_phy_bmcr = 0;
 	}
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/net/usb/asix_devices.c`**
   - Removed the call to `mii_nway_restart(&dev->mii);` which is not power management (pm) aware and can lead to a deadlock.
   - Added a manual implementation of the functionality of `mii_nway_restart` by checking if `BMCR_ANENABLE` is set in `priv->presvd_phy_bmcr`. If it is, `BMCR_ANRESTART` is set in `priv->presvd_phy_bmcr`.

### Relationships Between Modifications

The modification in `asix_devices.c` directly addresses the issue of a deadlock that occurs when the `mii_nway_restart` function is called during the resume path of a USB network interface. By replacing the call to `mii_nway_restart` with a manual check and setting of the `BMCR_ANRESTART` bit, the patch ensures that the power management state is respected, thus preventing the deadlock scenario when the device is resumed from a low power state. This change is a corrective measure to improve the stability of the network interface during power management transitions.

Here is the commit message:
net: usb: asix: replace mii_nway_restart in resume path

mii_nway_restart is not pm aware which results in a rtnl deadlock.
Implement mii_nway_restart manual by setting BMCR_ANRESTART if
BMCR_ANENABLE is set.

To reproduce:
* plug an asix based usb network interface
* wait until the device enters PM (~5 sec)
* `ip link set eth1 up` will never return

Fixes: d9fe64e51114 ("net: asix: Add in_pm parameter")
Signed-off-by: Alexander Couzens <lynxis@fe80.eu>
Signed-off-by: David S. Miller <davem@davemloft.net>

Here is the root cause:
The function `mii_nway_restart` is not aware of power management states, which can lead to a deadlock when the device is resumed from a low power state. This occurs because the function attempts to restart the auto-negotiation process without considering whether the device is in a proper state to do so, resulting in a failure to complete the operation and causing the `ip link set eth1 up` command to hang indefinitely.

Here is the patch:
 
 static void ax88772_restore_phy(struct usbnet *dev)
 {
 	struct asix_common_private *priv = dev->driver_priv;
 
 	if (priv->presvd_phy_advertise) {
 		/* Restore Advertisement control reg */
 		asix_mdio_write_nopm(dev->net, dev->mii.phy_id, MII_ADVERTISE,
 				     priv->presvd_phy_advertise);
 
 		/* Restore BMCR */
+		if (priv->presvd_phy_bmcr & BMCR_ANENABLE)
+			priv->presvd_phy_bmcr |= BMCR_ANRESTART;
+
 		asix_mdio_write_nopm(dev->net, dev->mii.phy_id, MII_BMCR,
 				     priv->presvd_phy_bmcr);
 
-		mii_nway_restart(&dev->mii);
 		priv->presvd_phy_advertise = 0;
 		priv->presvd_phy_bmcr = 0;
 	}
 }

This function attempts to restart the auto-negotiation process without ensuring that the device is in a proper state, causing the `ip link set eth1 up` command to hang indefinitely.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
+		if (priv->presvd_phy_bmcr & BMCR_ANENABLE)
+			priv->presvd_phy_bmcr |= BMCR_ANRESTART;
```
Reason:
This code checks if the `BMCR_ANENABLE` bit is set before manually setting the `BMCR_ANRESTART` bit. This ensures that the auto-negotiation restart is only attempted when the device is in a suitable state, thus preventing the deadlock that occurs when `mii_nway_restart` is called without considering the power management state.
